name: amadeus-project
description: 本地数字生命体实验：情感连续性、长期记忆、自主陪伴。基于 digital_life 五模块与 Ollama 本地推理。

scripts.voice:devices: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path .venv-voice\Scripts\python.exe) { .\.venv-voice\Scripts\python.exe voice_daemon\amadeus_voice_daemon.py devices } else { python voice_daemon\amadeus_voice_daemon.py devices }"
scripts.voice:enroll: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path .venv-voice\Scripts\python.exe) { .\.venv-voice\Scripts\python.exe voice_daemon\amadeus_voice_daemon.py enroll --seconds 25 --speaker owner } else { python voice_daemon\amadeus_voice_daemon.py enroll --seconds 25 --speaker owner }"
scripts.test: node --test tests/pad.test.js tests/chatTurns.test.js tests/chatTurnRegistry.test.js tests/oocGuard.test.js tests/replyLanguage.test.js tests/startupCheck.test.js tests/digital_life.test.js tests/autonomy.test.js tests/conversationInitiative.test.js tests/memoryAdmission.test.js tests/evolution.test.js tests/understanding.test.js tests/embodiment.test.js tests/metacognition.test.js tests/architecture.test.js tests/productContract.test.js tests/butler.test.js tests/apiSmoke.test.js tests/brain.smoke.test.js tests/brain.worldModel.test.js tests/brain.probes.test.js tests/brain.consciousness.test.js tests/finetuneDataset.test.js
